content.value: A dc separately excited motor is powered by a dc chopper as shown in $\mathrm { F i g } \dot { . } \ddot { 8 } ( \mathrm { d } )$ from a 600v dc source. The armature resistance $\mathrm { R } _ { a } { = } 0 . 0 5 \Omega$ The back emf constant of motor is $\mathrm { k _ { v } = 1 . 5 2 7 v / A \mathrm { - r a d / s } }$ . The average armature current is $\mathrm { I } _ { \mathsf { a } } { = } 2 5 0 \mathrm { A }$ The field current is $\mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { f } } { = } 2 . 5 \mathrm { A }$ .
